Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

#include<vector>
#include<algorithm>
#include<iostream>
#include<unordered_map>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    int findLHS(vector<int>& nums) {
        unordered_map<int, int> dict;
        int n = nums.size();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            dict[nums[i]]++;
        
        int maxLen = 0;
        for (auto it = dict.begin(); it != dict.end(); ++it)
        {
            int k = it->first;
            if (dict.find(k + 1) != dict.end())
            {
                maxLen = max(maxLen, it->second + dict[k + 1]);
            }
        }
        return maxLen;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    vector<int> nums = {1, 3, 2, 2, 5, 2, 3, 7};
    auto res = sol.findLHS(nums);
    cout << res << endl;

    return 0;
}
